visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A young woman is seen from behind, lying on a grey sofa in a modern living room. She is watching a historical drama on a large flat-screen TV and raises her arms in a big stretch, wearing a pink striped shirt. (2) The scene cuts to a medium close-up of the woman facing the camera. She has long dark hair pulled back and points at her under-eye area with her index finger, showing a worried expression. (3) The woman is now wearing a black and white textured knit vest and a silver necklace. She holds up two black tubes of Maybelline Fit Me concealer towards the camera, smiling and talking directly to the viewer. (4) A close-up view shows the woman applying the concealer using a wand applicator under her eye. The product is a light peach tone. She then uses a makeup sponge to dab and blend the product into her skin. (5) She displays a set of five concealer tubes held in her hands. A close-up shows five different shades swatched on her forearm, ranging from light peach to deep beige. (6) The woman applies more product to specific areas: the wings of her nose and the corners of her mouth. Text labels appear over these areas to indicate the purpose. (7) A side-by-side comparison shows the 'Before' side with visible dark circles and the 'After' side with smooth, even skin tone. She points to the results with a smile. (8) She holds up a glass bottle of Maybelline Fit Me Pro foundation. She applies a large dab to her cheek and blends it out with a sponge. The finish looks matte and uniform. (9) The final scene shows her looking refreshed with full makeup. She is in a different setting, possibly a hallway with warmer artificial lighting, demonstrating the makeup's durability.

audio_base.audio_narrative_log: (1) The audio begins with a soft yawn from the girl, followed by the start of a light, upbeat acoustic pop track featuring rhythmic guitar strumming. Her voice is initially slightly tired but playful. (2) A sudden shift occurs as she gasps in surprise, her pitch rising sharply as she exclaims about the time being 4:30 AM. High arousal is evident in her tone. (3) Transitioning into a professional review style, her voice becomes energetic and clear. Subtle bubble pop SFX emphasize the appearance of product names and key features. (4) Detailed instructional narration follows, where she explains blending techniques with a steady, encouraging pace. The BGM maintains a consistent beat, providing a cheerful backbone to the product tutorial. (5) In the final phase, her voice drops slightly in pitch but remains enthusiastic as she shows the long-lasting effects. The audio track ends with a clean cut after her final recommendation.
